name: comment-cut
description: Cut comment bloat out of a branch without losing the comments that matter. Sweeps the mechanical classes, then judges area by area against four narrow keep-rules, each needing a failure that nothing reports AND a tempting edit that would cause it — a visible bug is a missing test, not a comment. Specs default to zero, on the principle that a red test is not a silent failure. The default action is delete, not tighten. Verification is the point: a comments-only change is proven by comparing esbuild minified output, so a stray string-literal or logic edit cannot pass, and an invariant-signal scan over every removed line catches the over-cut that typechecks and tests cannot see. Reads its keep/cut bar from the target repo, never from a copy baked into the plugin.
